title: A Survey on Large Language Models with Multilingualism: Recent Advances and New Frontiers

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating performance degradation and capability disparities in Large Language Models when generalized to non-English and low-resource languages due to imbalanced training corpora.

Reviewing existing benchmarks and datasets (e.g., MGB, MIBs, MozArt) that measure exact label matches, cross-lingual word embedding biases, and occupational stereotype associations across multiple languages.
Surveying evaluation datasets like RTP-LX used to identify culture-specific toxic language, identity attacks, insults, and microaggressions in multilingual scenarios.
